stories.title: Russian strikes kill 11 in Ukraine after Trump gets diesel deal with Moscow

en.title: Russian strikes kill 11 in Ukraine after Trump gets diesel deal with Moscow
en.summary: Russian military strikes resulted in 11 deaths in Ukraine. The strikes followed President Trump's announcement of an agreement to purchase Russian diesel, which Ukraine claims would financially support Moscow's war effort.
